children: Networking startup Eliyan, which was valued at $1 billion in July, has disclosed to some of its investors in the last few days that it received a takeover offer.

Eliyan has been working with an advisor since the summer and likely wants a valuation of $3 billion, according to a  report from The Information on Thursday, which cited people familiar with the matter.

, an existing investor in Eliyan, held early discussions about possibly acquiring the company, but it didn't make an offer and would be unlikely to do so at that valuation, a person familiar with the matter told the publication.
Spokespeople for Eliyan and Arm declined to comment to The Information.

title: Networking startup Eliyan gets takeover interest, held early talks with Arm - report
